raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-18 payments-source sends reversals as separate REVERSAL records and leaves the original as POSTED. The silver filter keeps those originals and drops the REVERSAL rows, so reversed amounts are never netted out and gold totals run high. The fix excludes any POSTED original that a REVERSAL record points to, matching how older REVERSED originals were already excluded; the NOT EXISTS form avoids the NULL trap of NOT IN on the nullable orig_txn_id.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id);"}}
